description:
You are investigating why fleet task {{event.task_id}} ("{{event.title}}") got blocked.
Blocked at: {{event.blocked_at}}
Fleet's reason: {{event.blocked_reason}}
Attempt rounds so far: {{event.rounds}}. Worker-declared result status: {{event.result_status}}
Task folder (read-only for you): {{event.task_dir}}
Repository the task worked in: {{event.cwd}}

Read, in this order:
1. {{event.task_dir}}/task.json (routing, blocked_reason, attempts)
2. {{event.task_dir}}/attempts.jsonl and the newest {{event.task_dir}}/attempts/<n>/ folder:
   run.json, log.stderr, the tail of events.jsonl, prompt.md
3. {{event.task_dir}}/STATE.md and RESULT.json when present
4. The task's own description: run `cd ~/.fleet && bd show {{event.task_id}}`
5. Only then look at the repository at {{event.cwd}} (git log -5, git status, the files the task touched).

Last stderr/summary tail fleet saw:
{{event.stderr_tail}}

Write $FLEET_TASK_DIR/artifacts/INVESTIGATION.md (max 8 KB) with these sections:
- Root cause: one paragraph, plain language.
- Evidence: the exact log lines / files / commands that prove it.
- Category: one of  environment | prompt-or-spec | code-bug | flaky-or-rate-limit | merge-conflict | needs-human-decision
- Recommended action: exactly one of  unblock-as-is | unblock-after: <what to change in the spec or repo> | close: <why the task is obsolete or done> | needs-human: <the question>
- Confidence: high | medium | low, with one sentence why.

Then attach a short summary to the blocked task so the human sees it there:
  cd ~/.fleet && bd comment {{event.task_id}} "Investigation: <category>; recommended: <action>. Full report: $FLEET_TASK_DIR/artifacts/INVESTIGATION.md"

Rules:
- Do NOT change any file in the repository and do NOT commit. This is analysis only.
- Do NOT unblock, close, reopen or edit task {{event.task_id}}; do NOT write inside {{event.task_dir}}.
- Do not run `fleet run`, `fleet serve` or kill processes.
- Finish by writing $FLEET_TASK_DIR/RESULT.json with status "done" and a one-line summary, then `bd close $FLEET_TASK_ID --reason "investigated {{event.task_id}}: <category>"`.
name: Blocked task investigator
title: Investigate blocked task {{event.task_id}}: {{event.title}}
